leads.name: Trzy Zorze (The Three Auroras)
leads.why: Officially protected as a single nature-monument entry (Uchwala nr 812/18 Rady Miasta Torunia, 22 lutego 2018), a group of three Scots pines with one popular name, one street address (ul. Pawia, Wrzosy forestry district) and one shared coordinate. Girths corroborated identically by two independent sources: pl.wikipedia's 'Pomniki przyrody w Toruniu' (reproducing the city's own register) and PTTK's own walking-route writeup, both giving 320, 195 and 210 cm. No age recorded anywhere; left empty rather than guessed. Passes the ensemble test (one register entry, one name, one place to stand), on a forest road PTTK runs organised walks past, beside a 403cm protected pedunculate oak and the 'Monument to the Polish Mother' (1933) noted by the same sources as worth researching alongside it for a future Torun cluster. Full verified record in data/research/famouspoland-refill-verified.json.
